prompt: The camera pans slowly left to right, keeping pace with the chestnut WAGES as it trots alone through the flooded straight, rider sitting quietly, water splashing knee-high with every stride. Rain hammers the puddles into rings; the vast empty stand looms grey and silent, rows of seats gleaming wet. The horse gives a little shake of its head and carries on, steady and alone, the white rail running beside it. Sound: steady downpour, splashing hooves, a distant gust, no crowd, no talking. Real-looking footage of an English racecourse on a grey, wet day. Thanks.
